messages:
elaine: FYI a banking customer wants eval-triggered advisor recs that suggest batching/caching/quant profiles whenever we detect quality or latency drift. they want actionable recs + a safe apply flow.

raj: MVP thoughts: 1) alerts fired by eval-sentry on prompt-sets, 2) rule-based recs (batch, cache ttl, quant) with simple expected-impact estimate, 3) UI card with 'copy config' and 'preview impact' — no auto-apply for MVP.

kevin: agree. implement advisor as a post-process on drift events. sample rule:```
trigger: latency_median > 300ms
recommend: batch_size=1, quant=int8_dynamic, cache_ttl=120
metrics_estimate: latency -20%, cost -10%, quality_estimate: -0.5%
```
we'll only suggest model-variant changes if replay on a golden set shows <=0.5% quality delta.

elaine: ops requirements: audit log for every suggestion + who applied it, rollback button, and safe RBAC. pilot acceptance: FP rate <10%, at least 10% cost saving in 50% of applied recs, and no customer-visible regressions during pilot.

opsbot: created ticket PROD-5891 for advisor MVP (assignee: kevin).

raj: next steps: kevin spike heuristics + small demo in 1 week; elaine draft pilot runbook; i'll write short customer comms. meet Fri 20m to align.

kevin: sounds good — will mock UI card and rules table for demo.

elaine: thanks all. :thumbsup:
